prompt: ok so i've had this idea rattling around for a while - a water intake tracker. nothing fancy. i drink way too little water and every app i've tried is either bloated with calorie counting or wants $9.99/mo for a glass icon. i can code a bit (js mostly) but i've never shipped a mobile app. where do i even start? i'd want it on both iphone and android eventually

assertions.text: Walks the 5-step MVP design framework by name (core function, core loop, accessory features, surface area check, retention hook) before proposing any code
States a concrete screen budget of roughly 5-7 screens as an anti-bloat constraint
Specifies that the core loop's reward must be sensory (haptics, sound/chime, or animation) rather than merely informational
Names the architecture ladder or otherwise explicitly starts local with no database, deferring cloud/DB to a later rung
Recommends Expo / React Native as the route to both iOS and Android from one JS codebase
Does not dump a project scaffold, file tree, or implementation code before the MVP design is settled
When proposing a retention mechanic, is candid that engineered incompletion is a manipulation pattern rather than presenting it as neutral craft
